export const MODULES={DASHBOARD:'DASHBOARD',CHILDREN:'CHILDREN',THERAPY:'THERAPY',ASSESSMENTS:'ASSESSMENTS',NUTRITION:'NUTRITION',OUTREACH:'OUTREACH',CHALLENGES:'CHALLENGES',SUCCESS_STORIES:'SUCCESS_STORIES',REPORTS:'REPORTS',USER_MANAGEMENT:'USER_MANAGEMENT',DEVICES:'DEVICES',TRAINING:'TRAINING',MEETINGS:'MEETINGS',COMMUNITY:'COMMUNITY',FOOD_PARCELS:'FOOD_PARCELS',EDUCATIONAL_MATERIALS:'EDUCATIONAL_MATERIALS',SENSORY_DEVICES:'SENSORY_DEVICES'};export const ACTIONS={VIEW:'VIEW',CREATE:'CREATE',EDIT:'EDIT',DELETE:'DELETE',APPROVE:'APPROVE',GENERATE_REPORT:'GENERATE_REPORT',VIEW_REPORT:'VIEW_REPORT',EDIT_REPORT:'EDIT_REPORT',DELETE_REPORT:'DELETE_REPORT',MANAGE_USERS:'MANAGE_USERS',MANAGE_SETTINGS:'MANAGE_SETTINGS'};// Role-to-permission mapping (fallback if backend doesn't provide permissions)
export const ROLE_PERMISSIONS={Administrator:{modules:Object.values(MODULES),actions:Object.values(ACTIONS)},'Program Manager':{modules:[MODULES.DASHBOARD,MODULES.CHILDREN,MODULES.THERAPY,MODULES.ASSESSMENTS,MODULES.NUTRITION,MODULES.OUTREACH,MODULES.SUCCESS_STORIES,MODULES.REPORTS,MODULES.DEVICES,MODULES.TRAINING,MODULES.MEETINGS,MODULES.COMMUNITY,MODULES.FOOD_PARCELS,MODULES.EDUCATIONAL_MATERIALS,MODULES.SENSORY_DEVICES],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW,ACTIONS.CREATE,ACTIONS.EDIT,ACTIONS.DELETE,ACTIONS.GENERATE_REPORT]},'Executive Officer':{modules:[MODULES.DASHBOARD,MODULES.CHILDREN,MODULES.THERAPY,MODULES.ASSESSMENTS,MODULES.NUTRITION,MODULES.OUTREACH,MODULES.SUCCESS_STORIES,MODULES.REPORTS,MODULES.DEVICES,MODULES.TRAINING,MODULES.MEETINGS,MODULES.COMMUNITY,MODULES.FOOD_PARCELS,MODULES.EDUCATIONAL_MATERIALS,MODULES.SENSORY_DEVICES],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW,ACTIONS.CREATE,ACTIONS.EDIT,ACTIONS.DELETE,ACTIONS.GENERATE_REPORT]},'M&E Personnel':{modules:[MODULES.DASHBOARD,MODULES.CHILDREN,MODULES.THERAPY,MODULES.ASSESSMENTS,MODULES.NUTRITION,MODULES.OUTREACH,MODULES.SUCCESS_STORIES,MODULES.REPORTS,MODULES.DEVICES,MODULES.TRAINING,MODULES.MEETINGS,MODULES.COMMUNITY,MODULES.FOOD_PARCELS,MODULES.EDUCATIONAL_MATERIALS,MODULES.SENSORY_DEVICES],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW,ACTIONS.CREATE,ACTIONS.EDIT,ACTIONS.DELETE,ACTIONS.GENERATE_REPORT]},Therapist:{modules:[// Therapist has full access to all modules except user management and settings
MODULES.DASHBOARD,MODULES.CHILDREN,MODULES.THERAPY,MODULES.ASSESSMENTS,MODULES.NUTRITION,MODULES.OUTREACH,MODULES.SUCCESS_STORIES,MODULES.DEVICES,MODULES.TRAINING,MODULES.MEETINGS,MODULES.COMMUNITY,MODULES.FOOD_PARCELS,MODULES.EDUCATIONAL_MATERIALS,MODULES.SENSORY_DEVICES,MODULES.REPORTS// Therapist can view reports but not generate? We'll allow view only
],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW,ACTIONS.CREATE,ACTIONS.EDIT,ACTIONS.DELETE,ACTIONS.VIEW_REPORT]},// These roles are active and assignable. They have their specific modules.
'M&E Officer':{modules:[MODULES.DASHBOARD,MODULES.CHILDREN,MODULES.THERAPY,MODULES.ASSESSMENTS,MODULES.NUTRITION,MODULES.OUTREACH,MODULES.SUCCESS_STORIES,MODULES.REPORTS,MODULES.DEVICES,MODULES.TRAINING,MODULES.MEETINGS,MODULES.COMMUNITY,MODULES.FOOD_PARCELS,MODULES.EDUCATIONAL_MATERIALS,MODULES.SENSORY_DEVICES],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW,ACTIONS.CREATE,ACTIONS.EDIT,ACTIONS.DELETE,ACTIONS.GENERATE_REPORT]},'Nutrition Officer':{modules:[MODULES.DASHBOARD,MODULES.NUTRITION,MODULES.CHILDREN,MODULES.ASSESSMENTS,MODULES.FOOD_PARCELS,MODULES.REPORTS],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW,ACTIONS.CREATE,ACTIONS.EDIT,ACTIONS.DELETE]},'Caregiver Trainer':{modules:[MODULES.DASHBOARD,MODULES.TRAINING,MODULES.CHILDREN,MODULES.ASSESSMENTS,MODULES.REPORTS],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW,ACTIONS.CREATE,ACTIONS.EDIT,ACTIONS.DELETE]},'Community Outreach Officer':{modules:[MODULES.DASHBOARD,MODULES.OUTREACH,MODULES.COMMUNITY,MODULES.CHILDREN,MODULES.ASSESSMENTS,MODULES.REPORTS],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW,ACTIONS.CREATE,ACTIONS.EDIT,ACTIONS.DELETE]},Guest:{modules:[MODULES.DASHBOARD],actions:[ACTIONS.VIEW]}};// Helper to check if user has permission
export const hasPermission=(user,module,action)=>{if(!user)return false;if(user.is_superuser)return true;// If user has a `permissions` array (from backend), use that
if(user.permissions&&Array.isArray(user.permissions)){return user.permissions.some(p=>p.module===module&&p.action===action);}// Fallback: use role-based mapping
const role=user.role||'Guest';const perm=ROLE_PERMISSIONS[role];if(!perm)return false;return perm.modules.includes(module)&&perm.actions.includes(action);};// Convenience helpers
export const canViewModule=(user,module)=>hasPermission(user,module,ACTIONS.VIEW);export const canCreate=(user,module)=>hasPermission(user,module,ACTIONS.CREATE);export const canEdit=(user,module)=>hasPermission(user,module,ACTIONS.EDIT);export const canDelete=(user,module)=>hasPermission(user,module,ACTIONS.DELETE);export const canGenerateReports=user=>hasPermission(user,MODULES.REPORTS,ACTIONS.GENERATE_REPORT);export const canManageUsers=user=>hasPermission(user,MODULES.USER_MANAGEMENT,ACTIONS.MANAGE_USERS);// Get all modules the user can access (at least VIEW)

default:return true;// Let the router handle 404s/other routes
}};
